messages:
Casey: Quick micro-pack for managers doing calibration notes. Need 1-line context for adjusted timelines and a 2-sentence promotion seed.

Ivy: Make the promotion seed emphasize scope and mentoring.

Marco: Also add a tiny checklist for docs/PRs to paste.

Casey: Draft below.

Casey: --- CALIBRATION NOTE: ADJUSTED TIMELINE LINE ---
"Note: reduced capacity Q2 due to medical leave; achievements reflect condensed timeline."

Casey: --- PROMOTION SEED (2 sentences) ---
"[Name] has expanded scope by leading cross-team reliability work and consistently mentoring peers. Recommend promotion conversation to formalize broader ownership."

Casey: --- DOCS/PR CHECKLIST ---
- PRs: #432, #478
- Dashboards: latency_p95, cost_per_request
- Internal note: design doc link

PeopleBot: Reminder: Calibration meeting scheduled next Tuesday 10:00.

Ivy: Perfect, keeping it short. I'll merge into the manager guide.

Marco: Thanks!

Casey: Tag me if you want examples from last cycle.

PeopleBot: Automated: Office hours tomorrow 14:00-15:00 for calibration help.
